name: ConvertCalculator | Create powerful calculators, quote forms, lead funnels, and more without code
author: jorisderuiter

sections.description:
Easily build calculators for your landing pages and web applications with Convert_’s intuitive calculator builder.

Create unlimited calculators

  • Price Calculator – Let customers calculate pricing and pay you
  • Price Quotation – Create an efficient price quoting system for your business.
  • Invoicing Software – Create professional invoices.
  • Ecommerce Tools – Develop calculators tailored for e-commerce.
  • Mini-Applications – Enhance engagement with interactive mini-apps.
  • Online Surveys – Gather insights efficiently.
  • Finance Calculators – Help users make informed financial decisions.
  • Lead Capture – Create high-converting lead capture forms.
  • Interactive Calculators – Make your website more engaging with dynamic tools.
  • Booking Forms – Convert visitors into guests with seamless booking forms.
  • Product Configurator – Build product configurators for your webshop.
  • Sales Funnel – Automate and improve conversion rates.
  • Quiz Generator – Boost sales with interactive lead generation quizzes.
  • Estimate Forms – Foster transparency and trust with accurate estimates.
  • PDF Quotes – Generate professional PDF quotes.
  • CPQ (Configure-Price-Quote) – Enable quick and accurate price configuration.
  • ROI Calculator – Demonstrate the return on investment visually.
  • Order Forms – Accept payments seamlessly with online order forms.

View all templates

Flexible calculators for every industry

  • Screen Printing – Let customers create their own quotes.
  • Solar Energy – Automate solar energy quotes and processes.
  • Photographers – Offer 24/7 automated quoting for clients.
  • Restaurants & Food Delivery – Streamline ordering and payments.
  • Marketers – Generate more leads efficiently.
  • Tiny House Builders – Optimize pricing and boost profit margins.
  • Lawn Care Businesses – Provide accurate lawn care pricing calculators.
  • Sustainability Startups – Improve lead generation and conversions.
  • Cleaning Businesses – Enhance efficiency with automated processes.
  • Carpet Cleaning Services – Increase leads and bookings effortlessly.

and more!

Learn how to build your first calculator

Simple yet powerful features

  • Charts & Graphs – Interactive visual elements for data presentation.
  • Number Fields – Input numerical values for precise calculations.
  • Date & Time Fields – Capture time-sensitive information effortlessly.
  • Dataset Tables – Handle large data sets effectively.
  • Layered Images – Build engaging product configurators.
  • eSignature Element – Enable digital signatures on your forms.
  • Logic Engines – Power up your no-code apps with logic-based workflows.
  • Coupon Fields – Incorporate discount options seamlessly.
  • Payment Integration – Capture payments through your calculator forms.
  • Multi-Page Forms – Enhance user experience with structured multi-page forms.
  • Conditional Logic – Show or hide fields dynamically based on user input.
  • Advanced Calculations – Implement custom formulas in your forms.
  • Multiple Choice Fields – Dropdowns, radio buttons, and button groups for user input.
  • Versatile Form Elements – Build forms with limitless customization.
  • Location Entry – Integrate maps and places for accurate location data collection.
  • File Upload Fields – Allow users to upload documents with ease.

Need it yesterday? Let us build the calculator for you.

Don’t have the time or energy to create a calculation form yourself? Then let us build the form for you with our Concierge service. We will do the heavy lifting and afterwards, you can always make changes yourself.

Explore Concierge Service

Requirements

The plugin requires a ConvertCalculator account. Sign up for free at http://www.convertcalculator.com.
sections.installation:
Installing “ConvertCalculator” can be done either by searching for “ConvertCalculator” via the “Plugins > Add New” screen in your WordPress dashboard, or by using the following steps:

  1. Download the plugin via WordPress.org.
  2. Upload the ZIP file through the “Plugins > Add New > Upload” screen in your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  4. Make sure you have a calculator ready to be embedded. You can build one via http://www.convertcalculator.com/app
  5. Navigate to your calculator (on http://www.convertcalculator.com/app) and click on “Embed on your website”. Copy the calculator id
  6. Place the calculator on your site using one of the following methods:
    a. Add a ConvertCalculator block and follow the instructions to add a calculator to your page.
    b. Insert a shortcode into page or post content like this [convertcalculator id="CALC_ID"].
    c. Place <?php convertcalculator_add_calculator($calculator_id); ?> in your template(s). This function call takes up to one required parameter: the id parameter, which is the id you just copied.

NB. If you need to use our legacy “in-page” embed method, add the “type” property to the shortcode, like this: [convertcalculator id="CALC_ID" type="in-page"]
